description:
About the job

Growth & Performance Marketing Specialist




Remote (Latin America-based; CST time zone preferred; English-fluent)

Department: Marketing

Reports to: Director of Marketing

Direct reports: None

Company size: ~65 employees




About Tricura:




Tricura Insurance Group is a next-generation, tech-enabled insurance and risk management company transforming how healthcare organizations protect, manage, and grow their operations.




We're a global, remote-first team headquartered in New York, combining deep insurance expertise with modern technology to build smarter, faster, and more transparent solutions for the healthcare industry.




We're a team across North and South America, building products and internal systems that leverage AI, automation, and data to fundamentally improve how our business operates.




If you're excited by combining data, technology, and experimentation to solve complex growth challenges—and want to help build the marketing engine of a fast-growing company—we'd love to meet you.




About the Role:




We're looking for a highly analytical Growth & Performance Marketing Specialist to build and optimize the data-driven side of our marketing engine.




This is not a brand, creative, content, or social media role. We already have a strong team focused on brand positioning, design, messaging, content, and events.




Your role is to build the systems and campaigns that get that content in front of the right people, at the right time—and determine whether it's actually influencing business outcomes.




You'll own performance marketing across channels such as Google and LinkedIn, develop account-based marketing (ABM) campaigns, build reliable marketing attribution and analytics, optimize conversion throughout the funnel, and continuously experiment with new ways to influence revenue.




Importantly, our challenge isn't simply generating more leads. We already have significant opportunity volume across our insurance and technology businesses. A major opportunity for this role is helping us convert existing demand more effectively by reaching known accounts and decision-makers with the right messages throughout their buying journey.




This is a highly quantitative individual contributor role. Success will be measured by campaign efficiency, funnel conversion, account engagement, attribution accuracy, pipeline impact, and marketing's contribution to revenue—not by the volume of content produced.




If you naturally gravitate toward dashboards, experiments, conversion rates, attribution, and figuring out why one campaign performs better than another, you'll thrive here.




What You'll Do:




1. Own Performance Marketing

Manage and optimize Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads campaigns
Develop targeting, audience segmentation, retargeting, and bidding strategies
Continuously optimize campaigns based on conversion and business performance
Test new audiences, channels, messages, calls to action, and campaign structures
Manage marketing spend with a strong focus on measurable business impact and ROI




2. Build Account-Based Marketing Programs

Develop and execute targeted ABM campaigns for high-value accounts and opportunities
Use known buying signals, account data, and decision timelines to determine when and how to engage prospects
Build campaigns that strengthen awareness, trust, and differentiation throughout the buying journey
Develop strategies for reaching multiple decision-makers within target organizations
Partner with Sales, Underwriting, and Marketing to identify high-value accounts and opportunities where marketing can influence conversion




3. Build Marketing Analytics & Attribution

Own marketing analytics, dashboards, and KPI reporting
Build reliable attribution between marketing activity, pipeline progression, and revenue
Track campaign performance beyond clicks and impressions to understand actual business impact
Analyze CAC, conversion rates, account engagement, pipeline influence, and campaign ROI
Identify performance trends, bottlenecks, and growth opportunities through data
Give leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where we should invest more




4. Improve Funnel Conversion

Analyze our commercial funnels to identify opportunities for marketing to improve conversion
Design campaigns aimed at moving existing opportunities through the funnel—not simply generating additional leads
Improve landing page conversion rates through continuous experimentation
Execute A/B tests across ads, landing pages, email campaigns, audiences, and calls to action
Develop campaigns around different stages of the buying journey
Partner with commercial teams to understand where and when marketing can most effectively influence buying decisions




5. Build Marketing Automation & Infrastructure

Develop and optimize HubSpot workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, and marketing automation
Improve how marketing data flows between campaigns, HubSpot, analytics platforms, and commercial teams
Build scalable processes for campaign tracking and reporting
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve marketing efficiency and execution speed
Continuously improve the infrastructure behind our digital marketing programs




6. Identify New Growth Opportunities

Identify new acquisition, engagement, and conversion channels
Monitor search behavior, competitor activity, and audience signals to uncover opportunities
Support paid search and SEO strategy around high-intent keywords
Develop and test hypotheses about new ways marketing can influence revenue
Help determine which marketing channels and strategies Tricura should scale over time




Who We're Looking For:




4+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Performance Marketing, or another highly quantitative B2B marketing role
Strong B2B marketing experience, ideally with complex products or services and longer sales cycles
Advanced hands-on experience with Google Ads
Advanced hands-on experience with LinkedIn Ads
Advanced knowledge of Google Analytics (GA4)
Strong HubSpot experience, including workflows, lifecycle automation, and reporting
Strong understanding of account-based marketing (ABM)
Experience building marketing dashboards, attribution models, and KPI reporting
Strong analytical and quantitative mindset
Excellent Excel or Google Sheets skills
Experience with A/B testing and conversion rate optimization
Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, funnel conversion, attribution, and campaign economics
Comfortable making decisions based on data rather than intuition
Comfortable independently building and optimizing campaigns rather than primarily coordinating agencies or external partners
Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment where experimentation is expected and priorities evolve quickly
Excellent English communication skills
Based in a Latin American country
Located in or able to work consistently within the Central Time Zone (CST/CDT)




Strong Plus:




Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, insurance, InsurTech, or B2B SaaS
Experience marketing complex or difficult-to-sell B2B products and services
Experience building sophisticated ABM programs
Experience with SEO and paid search strategy
Experience with Zapier, Make, or n8n
Familiarity with SQL, Looker Studio, or similar analytics tools
Experience using Claude or other AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, and campaign execution
Experience connecting HubSpot with other marketing, analytics, or revenue systems
Experience in a high-growth startup environment




Success in This Role:




Within your first year, you'll help us:

Build a scalable, measurable growth marketing engine
Improve conversion rates across our commercial funnels
Increase engagement with high-value accounts and decision-makers
Improve marketing-influenced pipeline and revenue
Build reliable attribution between marketing activity and commercial outcomes
Improve campaign efficiency and customer acquisition economics
Establish a sophisticated ABM capability
Identify which channels and campaigns generate the greatest business impact
Give leadership clear data to determine where we should scale marketing investment




Your performance will be evaluated through metrics such as:

Marketing Influenced Pipeline
Marketing Sourced Revenue
Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
Cost per Qualified Opportunity
Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
Funnel Conversion Rates
Landing Page Conversion Rate
Account Engagement
Marketing Attribution Accuracy

Build Tricura's performance and growth marketing capability from the ground up
Work on marketing initiatives directly connected to revenue and company growth
Experiment with ABM, performance marketing, AI, automation, and analytics
Work alongside strong creative, content, commercial, and technical teams
Join a fast-growing, AI-first company that embraces experimentation and modern technology
Fully remote team across North & South America
Competitive USD compensation
Unlimited PTO




How to Apply:




Please send your resume in English, along with a brief note explaining why you're interested in the role, directly to: DStranadko@tricurainsurance.io




Daria Stranadko

Head of People & Talent Development at Tricura

title: TikTok Shop - Creator Marketing & Operations Specialist - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a marketer with an analytical mind and creative to work on our creator ecosystem. You will be a strategic and executing part of the go-to-market of the program. Focusing on analyzing channels and communities to understand what creators need at every stage of their journey. You will also design and produce the marketing pieces that accelerate their growth, grow our own channels, and maintain a close relationship with the community. You will work directly with the Creator Marketing Lead and with stakeholders in Brand Marketing, Operations, Partner Management and regional teams. 

Responsibilities: 
- Co-design the affiliate program marketing strategy
- Identify growth levers, communication gaps and opportunities per segment 
- Translate channel and community performance findings into creative briefs
- Build message frameworks by creator journey stage - from awareness to discovery - and land them on concrete pieces with measurable results
- Produce the marketing pieces that execute the strategy with creative quality and branded voice.
- Design and run marketing experiments with clear metrics before scaling.
- Coordinate with freelancers, agencies and the internal design/video team to ensure timely deliverables 
- Manage the monthly editorial calendar of campaigns and communication, aligned to the program's milestones, e-commerce seasons (Hot Sale, Buen Fin, etc.) and the creator's journey.
- Adapt global/regional materials to the context of the Mexican market

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience in growth marketing, content marketing, brand, digital agency, creator/influencer marketing, CRM or similar roles 
- Hands on experience in production + data, focused on social networks and creators.
- Storytelling and copywriting.
- Knowledge of TikTok and content creators.
- Ability to produce content yourself when needed
- Experience with creative tools.
- Intermediate or above English

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in creator economy, MCN, affiliate programs, influencer agency or e-commerce brand.
- Background in growth marketing, performance marketing or CRM 
- Experience operating branded accounts on TikTok.
- Experience with SQL, Looker, Table or equivalents 
- Experience with email marketing / CRM platforms

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Evaluamos meticulosamente la productividad, el desempeño y el impacto de nuestras acciones utilizando métricas claras y objetivas. ¿Te identificas con todo esto?




Tu misión será diseñar, ejecutar y optimizar la estrategia de Lifecycle Marketing de Buk México, desarrollando contenidos personalizados y automatizaciones impulsadas por IA —con hiper personalización— que acompañen a prospectos y clientes durante todo su recorrido, maximizando conversión, engagement y pipeline.




¿Qué te espera?

Diseñar y ejecutar la estrategia de Lifecycle Marketing para cada etapa del funnel, incorporando estrategias de hiper personalización mediante IA.
Construir estrategias de Lead Nurturing y journeys inteligentes adaptativos.
Crear secuencias automatizadas para prospectos y automatizar procesos de producción de contenido.
Redactar y diseñar contenido de email relevante y persuasivo para campañas, newsletters para clientes, boletines para prospectos, invitaciones a eventos y webinars, correos de agradecimiento post eventos, comunicaciones de producto campañas de Customer Happiness, entre otros
Monitorear métricas, realizar pruebas A/B, implementar experimentación continua y optimizar campañas para mejorar el rendimiento del canal.
Coordinar campañas de email con equipos internos como CRM, Brand, Product Marketing, Customer Happiness y Ventas, integrando IA con CRM.
Explorar continuamente nuevas herramientas de IA aplicables al Lifecycle Marketing.
Apoyar en la redacción y diseño del contenido que funcione como lead magnets, entre ellos: ebooks, guías, manuales, miniguías, infografías y calculadoras.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Cultura de Innovación: En Buk, valoramos la creatividad y la proactividad. Trabajarás en un entorno que te brinda la libertad para proponer nuevas ideas y estrategias que impacten directamente en nuestra misión.
Desarrollo profesional: Trabajarás junto a un equipo de talento excepcional que te permitirá potenciar tus habilidades y crecer profesionalmente. Además,contarás con una plan de carrera para que puedas alcanzar tu potencial y crecer dentro de Buk.
Potenciamos tu aprendizaje: ¡Te ofrecemos más de 400 cursos a través de nuestra plataforma Bukplay para que puedas aprender y capacitarte en lo que tú quieras!
Programa 'Buk Culture Internship' y 'Exchange': Postula y participa de intercambios culturales en los países donde operamos. ¡Vive la experiencia de conocer a otros bukers y conviértete en embajador de nuestra cultura!
Flexibilidad con Responsabilidad: Sabemos que el equilibrio es clave. Tendrás la flexibilidad de trabajar desde donde te sientas más cómodo, siempre con la responsabilidad de alcanzar los objetivos.
Beneficios Revolucionarios: Desde “no política de vacaciones”, stock options y 5 semanas de post natal parental, hasta un plan de beneficios con puntos totalmente personalizado, ¡Te ofrecemos todo lo que necesitas para prosperar tanto personal como profesionalmente!




Un poco más sobre nosotros:

Hace 8 años comenzamos con un equipo de menos de 10 personas y hoy ya somos más de 1.700 bukers trabajando día a día para tener el Software de Gestión de Personas más completo del mercado. Esto, gracias a que hemos mantenido nuestro espíritu innovador y nuestra pasión por la tecnología y la excelencia. Además, nos encontramos presentes en Chile, Colombia, Perú, México y Brasil.




Te compartimos un video para que puedas ver cómo vivimos el día a día en Buk:

https://www.buk.mx/quienes-somos




¿Qué Buscamos?

Licenciatura en Marketing, Comunicación, Periodismo o carreras afines.
Experiencia de 2 a 4 años en Lifecycle Marketing, marketing automation y lead nurturing
Experiencia trabajando en empresas SaaS o B2B (ideal).
Experiencia demostrable en gestión y optimización de campañas de email marketing orientadas a conversión (customer journey, A/B testing, entre otros) y automatizaciones (deseable manejo de n8n)

About the job

Position

Digital Marketing Specialist – Virtual Experiences

Job Description

Arrow Electronics is a global provider of products, services, and solutions to industrial and commercial users of electronic components and enterprise computing solutions. Arrow Electronics guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of $30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. The company maintains 228 locations worldwide with over 85 countries served.

We are looking for a dedicated and detail‑oriented Digital Marketing Specialist – Virtual Experiences to join our Marketing Center of Excellence. In this role, you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end planning, execution, and optimization of webinars and virtual events delivered to global audiences. This position offers an opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment where operational excellence, process quality, and measurable business impact are key priorities.

What You’ll Be Doing


Planning and executing live webinars and virtual events end‑to‑end, including event setup, registration, live production, recording, and post‑event follow‑up.
Managing event logistics on virtual event platforms such as Microsoft Teams Live, ON24, GoToWebinar, or similar tools, ensuring a seamless attendee and speaker experience.
Building and coordinating event invitations and registrations, including audience segmentation, email communications, reminders, and real‑time registration monitoring.
Training and supporting internal and external speakers through platform guidance, rehearsals, and live technical moderation during events.
Acting as a virtual events platform administrator, maintaining templates, access, troubleshooting issues, and continuously improving engagement features such as polling, Q&A, or captions.
Managing a global virtual events calendar and collaborating with regional marketing teams across different time zones.
Coordinating with external agencies and vendors when additional production support is required, including budget and delivery oversight.

About the job

 A little bit about us:




We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.




We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.




We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.







About the team:




We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack. 
Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do. 
We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback. 
We communicate transparently. We do weekly all-hands where we get together to discuss company performance and goals.
While we are global and remote-friendly, we also operate from our vibrant offices in CDMX and Sao Paulo. To accommodate the various time zones in which we are based, we ensure we’re always synced up for at least 3 hours per day.
Also, we are backed by some of the leading investors in Silicon Valley and Latin America, including Founders Fund, Kaszek Ventures, and YCombinator.




Your opportunity:




As Sales Manager in Mexico City, you'll take on a people-leadership challenge at Belvo: managing and coaching a team of Account Executives. You'll stay close to the deals – managing your team, unblocking the pipeline, and rolling up your sleeves when needed – while growing Belvo's footprint with financial institutions, fintechs, and other regulated industries, as well as large enterprises across other sectors exploring open finance in Mexico.




Open finance is accelerating fast across Latin America – we've already connected more than 100 million accounts through Belvo-powered apps to share data or process payments – and this is your chance to build and coach the team that captures that opportunity locally. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys rolling up their sleeves and working hand-in-hand with their team to build the commercial engine that scales Belvo in Mexico.




Assist the team in the closing of key partnerships and accounts via demos, pre-sales calls, and in-person visits.
Master Belvo’s product and platform and be an expert resource on Belvo's current and future product offerings.
Work closely with our Product, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to ensure proper alignment in terms of market and client needs.

About the job

Job Description

At Zendesk, we are redefining the boundaries of Customer Experience (CX) and Employee Services (ES) through autonomous, Agentic AI and deep platform extensibility. As we build out the next generation of our global field organization, we are looking for builders, technical problem solvers, and curious minds who want to shape the future of enterprise automation.

We are seeking a technical Sales Engineer (SE) to join our specialized engineering presales team. In this role, you will get your hands dirty writing code, configuring complex API integrations, and building production-ready proof-of-concepts (POCs) that bring our advanced AI capabilities to life. This is a role designed for an engineer who loves solving complex puzzles, working closely with modern web tech stacks, and translating technical possibilities into functional solutions for our customers.

What You’ll Be Doing


Develop Proof-of-Concepts (POCs): Own the technical execution and delivery of customized product demonstrations, technical sandboxes, and tailored prototypes that prove the power of Zendesk’s platform and AI capabilities.
Build and Maintain API Integrations: Use your coding and scripting skills to connect Zendesk to complex client tech stacks, leveraging REST APIs, webhooks, middleware platforms, and modern cloud infrastructure.
Own Technical Validation: Partner with account teams to confidently handle deep-dive technical validations, Security/Architecture questionnaires, and developer-to-developer technical reviews.
Scale Internal Tooling: Collaborate with senior specialists to build, maintain, and document reusable code snippets, demo accelerators, and automation templates that elevate the speed of the entire field team.
Continuous Technical Learning: Stay on the cutting edge of modern software trends, actively developing your skills in Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and autonomous agent frameworks.


What You Bring (Required Qualifications)


Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related highly quantitative, technical discipline.
Experience: 2 to 4 years of professional experience in a technical client-facing role (e.g., Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, Implementation Consultant) or as a hands-on Software Developer looking to pivot into a strategic field role.
Core Technical Skills: Hands-on experience or academic proficiency with modern programming languages and web technologies (e.g., JavaScript, Python, Node.js) and working with REST/SOAP APIs.
Technical Curiosity: A strong foundational interest in AI technologies, including prompt engineering, LLMs, and autonomous software workflows.
Travel Commitment: Ability and willingness to travel between 30% and 50% annually for on-site technical workshops, team collaboration, and client validation sessions.


Preferred Qualifications


Familiarity with enterprise software infrastructure, cloud ecosystems (AWS, GCP, or Azure), or modern contact center architectures.
Experience presenting technical or architectural concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A portfolio of personal projects, GitHub contributions, or technical blogs that demonstrates your passion for building.


Who You Are


A Continuous Learner: You love dissecting new technologies and frameworks; you don't wait for a training module to learn how something works under the hood.
An Execution-Focused Builder: You thrive when given a complex technical problem, a blank IDE, and a deadline to build a working prototype.
A Strong Communicator: You can sit across from a customer's developer, understand their stack, and explain technical solutions in a highly collaborative, approachable way.


Please note that anyone hired into this position must be physically located in and plan to work from Mexico City (CDMX) or Mexico State (Estado de Mexico).

The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.

Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.

Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About the job

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico Lifestyles team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As a Vendor Specialist, you'll work with selected vendors to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

You’ll be responsible for looking after categories and brands´product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed monthly reports on performance. About the job

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Employee Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Trailhead

Trailhead is Salesforce's free online learning platform and the front door to the Salesforce ecosystem. It empowers anyone to build in-demand skills across AI, Agentforce, CRM, data, and business fundamentals — and helps organizations re-skill their workforce for the agentic era. The Trailhead Content team generates ideas, writes and edits content, develops hands-on challenges, and publishes and maintains the learning content that makes all of this possible. We believe content should be accessible, educational, relevant, and enjoyable. This is your chance to be part of it.

Role Description

As a Content Strategist, Emerging Products, you define the learning strategy for Salesforce's newest product innovations before they reach market. You embed early with our product and PPM teams to understand new product architectures, identify learner needs, and shape content plans ahead of general availability.

Salesforce ships new products fast, and learners need a way to build real skills the moment those products land. This role makes sure that learning is ready on day one, accurate, and built around what people actually need to do their jobs. As AI tools increasingly draw on Trailhead content to answer questions, getting that content right matters more than ever, for the human learning directly and for everything built on top of it.

Your Impact

Role

Success in this role is measured by your ability to ensure Trailhead has a structured, trustworthy content strategy in place at every emerging product launch:


Own content strategy for emerging Salesforce products, starting with Headless 360, so Trailhead has day-one learning content at each launch.
Partner with product and engineering teams before GA to build real product depth and shape content plans early.
Translate complex technical architectures into learner-centered strategies for multiple audiences: admins, developers, architects, and employees.
Build reusable frameworks and playbooks that cut time-to-publish as new products enter the portfolio.
Define the content structure and quality standards that let Trailhead serve as a trusted source for AI agents and MCP-driven experiences.
Use beta feedback, early adoption signals, and stakeholder input to validate direction and adjust as products evolve.


Required Skills & Experience


4+ years in content strategy, instructional design, or content development, in a technology or enterprise learning environment.
A track record of turning complex technical concepts into clear, learner-centered content for multiple audiences.
Experience partnering with product or engineering teams to build content plans that track to product development cycles.
Strong cross-functional skills, with a history of building real relationships across product, PMM, and learning teams.
Familiarity with content frameworks, scalable content architecture, and reusable program design.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience developing content in a pre-GA or early-access environment.
Understanding of how AI agents access and use structured content (MCP, RAG, or similar).
Active Salesforce certifications or hands-on experience building Trailhead content.
Experience using data and feedback to validate and iterate on content strategy.


What We Look For In Every Hire


Learner-first. You tie content programs to measurable outcomes and work with field and product teams to solve real skill gaps, not hypothetical ones.
A clear communicator. Your writing is direct and jargon-free. You respect people's time.
Collaborative by default: you seek out other perspectives, share work early, and give feedback that actually helps.
High ownership. You own outcomes, flag blockers before they become fires, and take bold positions when the evidence backs you, even when that's the harder road.
Curious about AI. You test AI tools for content work and design strategies that prepare learners for human-agent workflows.


Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, volunteer work, etc.).

NOTE: By applying to the Content Strategist, Emerging Products posting recruiters and hiring managers across the organization hiring these roles will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams.

Benefits & Perks


Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!
World-class enablement and on-demand training withTrailhead.com
Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1:1 coaching with leadership
Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1:1:1 model for giving back to the community
For more details, visithttps://www.salesforcebenefits.com/


In school, or graduated within the past 12 months? Please visit FutureForce for opportunities. 

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. SKILLS

1. Superior attention to detail and organizational skills.

As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Thomson Reuters, you will be responsible for generating qualified sales opportunities through outbound prospecting. You will engage decision makers in the US market, uncover business needs and pain points, and set value-focused appointments for Account Executives.

This role is ideal for commercially driven professionals who thrive in structured environments, enjoy complex B2B conversations, and want to build a long-term career in sales.

About The Role

In this opportunity as a Sales Development Representative, you will:


Prospect for new sales opportunities, develop a pipeline, & closes opportunity or may not execute renewal contracts.
Identifies upsell and cross-sell opportunities and passes them to an appropriate resource. 
Hit or exceed your monthly and annual targets and maintain consistently strong performance at 100% of your YTD goals. 
Work closely with the Sales Representatives assigned to you to align prospecting strategies and coordinate efforts with Training, Marketing, and Account Management teams.
Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline using a structured outbound sales process.
Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities within CRM and sales tools.
Develop strong product knowledge to clearly articulate business value to US-based customers.


About You

You’re a fit for the role if your background includes:


Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent work experience in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.
2+ years of B2B work experience in prospecting, sales, lead generation or preferred experience in software/SaaS market. 
Excellent verbal and written English communication.
Demonstrated ability to communicate professionally and influence over the phone, email and video
Strong interpersonal skills (personable and professional)
Ability to handle and overcome objections with confidence
Comfort working in quota-driven and KPI-based environments
Commitment to a schedule that coincides with the customer’s workday 
Intermediate computer skills and ability to navigate software programs, including CRM systems and tools.
Previous experience working with the US market (preferable but not mandatory)


Compensation: Base salary and a variable compensation that is directly related to your success.

To apply, please upload your updated resume in English. 

Location: CDMX

What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. About the job

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Role

You own Product & Lifecycle Growth marketing for Everand and Fable, end to end. Everand is our audiobook and ebook subscription product; Fable is our book-tracking and discovery community. Both are built for people who love books and reading. You'll set the positioning, plan the launches, build and ship the campaigns yourself, and measure what they move.

This is a senior individual contributor role built for a self-starter who is energized by both the strategy and the build. You'll go from a launch narrative one day to building the campaign in Iterable the next, and you'll go hands-on whenever that's the fastest path to impact.

What You'll Do


Own positioning and messaging for Everand and Fable across features, launches, and seasonal moments, tailored to each brand's audience and stage.
Lead go-to-market for new features and product updates, from concept through launch and adoption.
Build and ship the campaigns yourself across email, push, and in-app in Iterable, including audience segmentation and technical setup.
Partner with the dedicated lifecycle team to align launch moments with the always-on program, and own member and brand communications across those moments.
Partner with Product and Brand to shape the roadmap and keep messaging consistent with each brand's voice.
Define the metrics, set targets, instrument tracking before launch, and report on impact.
Test and iterate on messaging, timing, and targeting, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook.
Contribute to growth across the funnel, partnering with Product and Brand.


What You'll Bring


6+ years in growth, lifecycle, or product marketing in a subscription or consumer product business, with hands-on campaign execution.
A track record of owning GTM strategy and shipping the execution yourself.
Hands-on experience building campaigns in a marketing automation platform (Iterable or similar).
Strong writing skills, with the ability to own brand voice and turn it into copy that ships.
Comfort self-serving in data: you can read a query or dashboard and use it to make decisions.
A founder/owner mindset, you move on a priority without waiting for a fully specified brief, and a genuine love of books and reading.


At Scribd, Inc., your base pay is one part of your total compensation package and is determined within a range. Our pay ranges are based on the local cost of labor benchmarks for each specific role, level, and geographic location. San Francisco is our highest geographic market in the United States.

In the state of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $144,000 [minimum salary in our lowest geographic market within California] to $216,500 [maximum salary in our highest geographic market within California].

In the United States, outside of California, the reasonably expected salary range is between $119,000 [minimum salary in our lowest US geographic market outside of California] to $205,500 [maximum salary in our highest US geographic market outside of California].

In Canada, the reasonably expected salary range is between $151,000 CAD[minimum salary in our lowest geographic market] to $192,000 CAD[maximum salary in our highest geographic market].

We carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including but not limited to experience; job-related skill sets; relevant education or training; and other business and organizational needs. The salary range listed is for the level at which this job has been scoped. In the event that you are considered for a different level, a higher or lower pay range would apply. description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The Food Execution Team at DiDi is looking for a high-performing Intern Analyst to help drive sustainable growth and operational health for our top restaurants across Mexico, Colombia, Costa Rica, and Peru. In this role, you won't just execute strategies—you will help reshape how we work.

We are looking for a tech-savvy, strategic thinker who can leverage Python, automation, and AI integrations to optimize our day-to-day operations, support our field agents, and deliver top-tier market experiences for our clients. If you want to bridge the gap between high-level strategy and cutting-edge technical execution, this is your path to success.

Role Responsibilities

Data Analytics & Strategic Reporting


Insight Generation: Extract, manipulate, and analyze complex datasets to deliver actionable business insights and influence team decision-making.
KPI Management: Monitor, report, and maintain daily business KPIs, designing dashboards that track the operational health of our top regional restaurants.
Strategic Collaboration: Act as the analytical bridge to the Strategy Team, translating high-level goals into tactical, data-driven execution plans.
Experimentation: Constantly generate operational knowledge and validate process improvements through structured A/B testing.



Automation & AI Integration


Process Automation: Use Python to automate repetitive manual workflows, streamline data pipelines, and improve the efficiency of our support agents.
AI Solutions: Identify opportunities to integrate AI tools and frameworks into current processes to scale impact, improve response times, and optimize process standardization.
Process Engineering: Carry out root-cause analysis on operational bottlenecks and propose automated solutions to mitigate them.



In this role, you'll be...

What will you be doing?

Strategic Planning & Operational Execution


End-to-End Operational Ownership: Plan, analyze, and execute key operational activities, taking responsibility for the entire lifecycle of strategic initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal teams and the Sales Team to align daily operational execution with high-level commercial goals.
Process Optimization: Carry out root-cause analysis on operational challenges, designing data-backed solutions to improve process efficiency and standardize team KPIs.



Advanced Reporting & Data Analytics


Insight Generation: Extract and interpret complex business data to deliver actionable insights, uncover growth opportunities, and directly influence team decision-making.
Strategic Proposals: Formulate and pitch high-level, data-driven proposals aimed at scaling business impact and driving sustainable growth.



Automation & Process Engineering


Workflow Automation: Utilize Python and SQL to build automated reporting frameworks, streamline manual workflows, and optimize data pipelines.
AI Integration: Identify, test, and propose opportunities to integrate AI tools and models to enhance operational efficiency and future-proof current processes.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Role Qualifications

The Successful Applicant:


Academic Background: Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
Advanced Analytics & Scripting: Strong proficiency in Python (for data analysis and automation) and SQL (for data extraction). Familiarity with Claude Code CLI and R is a plus.
Core Tools: Advanced knowledge of Excel, Google Sheets (advanced formulas, pivot tables, complex data manipulation).
AI-Assisted Automation: Hands-on familiarity with Claude Code CLI or modern AI coding tools. You know how to use AI assistants through the command line to help write, debug, and automate Python scripts and basic data pipelines, moving beyond basic ChatGPT prompt engineering.
Mindset:
A strict KPI-driven and strategic mindset with a passion for problem-solving.
Highly self-motivated, proactive, and possesses a strong "owner attitude" to take challenges from ideation to execution.
Language Skills: Professional fluency in both English and Spanish (written and spoken) to effectively collaborate with our international team.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

title: Growth & Customer Success Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Growth & Customer Success Specialist en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y nuestro negocio de pagos (POS y online) crece fuerte. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar — y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con orientación a resultados, disciplina de seguimiento y calle para moverse en terreno, que entienda que cada comercio que crece con nosotros es una relación que construimos.




📍 Modalidad presencial / híbrida – base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.




Tu desafío: Hacer crecer el uso de nuestros medios de pago dentro de la cartera de comercios que ya son clientes (modelo LAND/EXPAND). No es cazar clientes nuevos: es que los que ya tenemos transaccionen más con nosotros.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Gestión activa de cartera: contacto proactivo y sostenido con los comercios de alto valor, con revisión de métricas de procesamiento por merchant.

• Subir la penetración GPV/GMV: mover a cada comercio sobre el umbral (≥50%) y empujarlo hacia 60% / 70%.

• Diagnosticar la fricción (técnica, UX, preferencia por competidor, desconocimiento de features) y resolver o escalar los obstáculos de procesamiento.

• Anti-arbitraje: detectar comercios que usan el split de boleta pero procesan la tarjeta en un POS de la competencia, y actuar sobre ello.

• Intervenir cuando las cuentas caen bajo el umbral o muestran señales de fuga.

• Aplicar pricing táctico dentro de los guardrails definidos.

• Recibir los comercios recién vendidos/activados y asumir la relación de crecimiento, coordinando con los hunters sin competir en la venta.

• Escalar necesidades de producto al PM.

• Alimentar los dashboards de penetración, GPV por cuenta y arbitraje, y participar en los ritmos semanales del equipo de Payments.




Requerimientos: 

• Formación en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín.

• Base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.

• 2–4 años en account management / KAM / customer success o gestión de cartera B2B, idealmente en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Orientación a GPV (volumen procesado), no a número de llamadas; track record de crecer revenue/engagement en cartera existente, no solo adquisición.

• Capacidad de leer data y dashboards, identificar patrones y priorizar comercios por oportunidad.

• Comunicación empática pero directa; cómodo visitando comercios y teniendo conversaciones difíciles.

• Autonomía y disciplina de seguimiento; trabaja en equipo con los hunters y activación sin competir (roles complementarios).




Suma puntos:

• Experiencia en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Experiencia en el sector belleza, salud o bienestar.

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos mexicano (Clip, Mercado Pago, Getnet, Netpay, bancos adquirentes)

About the job

Customer Experience & Travel Support Specialist

Location: Remote

Schedule: Part-Time | 20 hours/week | 9:00 AM EST




Overview

We’re looking for a warm, highly organized Customer Experience & Travel Support Specialist to support travelers throughout their journey, from their first inquiry through pre-departure.

You’ll be the go-to person for guest communication, bookings, payments, travel documentation, and CRM updates while helping create a smooth and memorable travel experience. This is a great opportunity for someone who genuinely loves travel and enjoys combining customer service with behind-the-scenes organization.




Key Responsibilities

Manage guest and prospective traveler communications via email with warmth, accuracy, and professionalism.
Answer questions about itineraries, logistics, payments, bookings, and travel documents, escalating sensitive matters when needed.
Draft and send pre-departure communications, reminders, follow-ups, and written recaps after guest calls.
Maintain accurate traveler records, bookings, payments, and guest information across CRM and booking systems.
Track deposits and final payment schedules and follow up on outstanding payments.
Coordinate updates to trip landing pages, pricing, availability, rosters, checklists, and shared travel documents.
Communicate with European partners, including hotels and concert venues, to coordinate logistics and relay updates internally.
Support occasional website and social media updates, including basic WordPress edits and Facebook or Instagram posts.




Requirements

Excellent written and spoken English.
Previous experience in customer support or another guest-facing role.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and customer conversations.
Confidence working across email, CRM systems, booking platforms, and other digital tools.
Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Google Docs, Sheets, Drive, and Gmail.
Handling customer data, payments, bookings, and travel documentation.




Nice to Have

Working proficiency in Spanish and/or German.
Experience in the travel or hospitality industry.
Familiarity with CRM systems or travel booking platforms such as WeTravel.
Firsthand international travel experience, particularly in Europe.
Familiarity with Facebook and Instagram content updates.




Why Join

Join a growing travel business where you can take ownership of the guest experience, learn the operational side of international travel, and potentially grow into sales and cruise booking responsibilities over time.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Our benefits package includes …


Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.

Employee Assistance Program
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

description:
About the job

Legal Intake Sales Representative (Qualifier)

 Full-Time | Remote | Exclusive Employment Required

 

 About the Role

 

 We are seeking a high-performing Legal Intake Sales Representative (Qualifier) to join our growing sales team. This role is responsible for qualifying inbound and outbound leads, gathering key case information, and warm-transferring qualified prospects to partner law firms.

 

 This is not a passive call-center role. Intake is sales. You will be measured, coached, and rewarded based on performance.

 

 You will work inside a best-in-class CRM and auto-dialer, supported by proven scripts, processes, and leadership that takes performance seriously.

 

 This is a full-time, exclusive role. Candidates may not work another job while employed in this position.

 

 What You’ll Do

 

 - Respond to new leads immediately to meet strict Speed-to-Lead standards

 - Conduct structured intake calls to qualify potential clients

 - Accurately collect and document case details in our CRM

 - Determine eligibility and warm-transfer qualified leads to partner law firms

 - Execute daily outbound follow-up calls using our dialer

 - Follow call scripts while sounding natural, empathetic, and confident

 - Maintain clean, complete, and accurate data on every call

 

 

 How You’ll Be Measured

 

 This is a performance-driven role. You will be graded on:

 

 - Speed to Lead (S2L)

 - Wanted Percentage (lead quality / qualification accuracy)

 - Data Integrity (CRM accuracy and call wrap-up)

 - Outbound Calls Per Day

 - # of missed calls per day

 

 Clear metrics. Clear expectations. Clear coaching.

 

 Compensation

 

 Base Salary ($6/hr-$8/hr)

 Performance-Based Bonus (typically $250–$500 per month, uncapped based on results)

 Bonuses are tied directly to your KPIs and consistency—not tenure

 

 What We’re Looking For

 - Sales-minded professionals who thrive in a metrics-driven environment

 - Strong verbal communication and active listening skills

 - Comfort handling sensitive conversations with empathy and confidence

 - Ability to follow systems, scripts, and processes precisely

 - High attention to detail and data accuracy

 - Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and professional phone presence

 - Legal intake or sales experience is a plus, but coachability matters more

 

 Why Join Us

 - You are not cold-calling blindly—you’re supported by real systems

 - Clear expectations and transparent performance tracking

 - Leadership that is hands-on, data-driven, and invested in your success

 - A sales culture that rewards execution, not politics

 - Opportunity to grow into higher-earning or senior sales roles

 

 To Apply

 Please submit your resume and a short minute long video introducing yourself.

 

 Important Note

 

 This position requires exclusive, full-time hours. Candidates who are currently working another job or planning to do so will not be considered.

En Anyness estamos buscando a nuestro próximo Sales & Account Manager, una persona comercial, consultiva y orientada a resultados, que nos ayude a construir relaciones sólidas con clientes y a convertir necesidades de negocio en soluciones tecnológicas de alto valor.




Buscamos a alguien que disfrute conversar con clientes, hacer las preguntas correctas, entender sus retos operativos y detectar oportunidades donde la tecnología, la inteligencia artificial, la automatización y los servicios digitales puedan generar impacto real.




¿Qué harás?




Serás responsable de acompañar al cliente durante todo el proceso comercial: desde el primer acercamiento y discovery, hasta la construcción de propuestas, negociación, cierre, renovación y seguimiento postventa.




Más que vender productos, buscamos que puedas entender el contexto del cliente, identificar sus dolores de negocio y conectar esas necesidades con soluciones de valor.




Tus principales responsabilidades serán:




✅ Gestionar y desarrollar cuentas medianas y corporativas dentro de Anyness.

✅ Atender y calificar leads generados por marketing, referidos, eventos o campañas.

✅ Prospectar nuevas oportunidades comerciales alineadas al mercado objetivo.

✅ Ejecutar reuniones de discovery para entender necesidades de negocio, operación y tecnología.

✅ Identificar oportunidades de IA, automatización, licenciamiento, servicios administrados y soluciones digitales.

✅ Construir propuestas comerciales claras, consultivas y alineadas al valor que podemos generar.

✅ Coordinarte con áreas internas para validar alcances, soluciones, tiempos y condiciones comerciales.

✅ Negociar condiciones comerciales y dar seguimiento hasta el cierre.

✅ Identificar oportunidades de renovación, expansión, venta cruzada y nuevos servicios.

✅ Mantener actualizado el pipeline comercial y CRM.

✅ Acompañar la experiencia del cliente después del cierre, asegurando seguimiento y continuidad.




¿Qué buscamos?




Nos encantaría conocerte si tienes:




• Experiencia de +3 años en ventas consultivas B2B, account management, desarrollo de negocio o gestión de cuentas.

• Experiencia deseable en empresas de tecnología, SaaS, servicios administrados, licenciamiento, cloud, ciberseguridad, Microsoft o soluciones digitales.

• Experiencia atendiendo clientes medianos, corporativos o enterprise.

• Capacidad para entender retos de negocio y traducirlos en oportunidades comerciales.

• Habilidad para hacer discovery, detectar necesidades y construir propuestas de valor.

• Facilidad para prospectar, dar seguimiento, negociar y cerrar oportunidades.

• Comunicación clara, profesional y consultiva.

• Organización y disciplina para gestionar pipeline, CRM y seguimiento comercial.

• Experiencia usando CRM como Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Pipedrive o similares.

• Curiosidad por tecnología, inteligencia artificial, automatización y transformación digital.




Este rol es para ti si…




Te gusta vender, pero no solo por vender.

Te interesa entender al cliente, detectar oportunidades reales, construir relaciones de largo plazo y acompañar el crecimiento de una cuenta.

Buscamos a alguien con hambre comercial, criterio, seguimiento, visión de negocio y gusto por las ventas consultivas.




Una persona que sepa escuchar, conectar ideas, negociar con estrategia y generar confianza con clientes.




Lo que ofrecemos




• Sueldo base competitivo: $18,000 - $22,000 brutos mensuales

• Esquema de comisiones

• Oportunidad de crecimiento en una empresa de tecnología e inteligencia artificial

• Exposición a soluciones de IA, Microsoft, automatización y servicios digitales

• Trabajo cercano con dirección y equipos estratégicos

• Prestaciones superiores a la ley

• Modalidad híbrida en Zapopan, Jalisco

• 2 días home office / 3 días presencial

• Oficinas en Av. Naciones Unidas




En Anyness creemos que vender tecnología no se trata solo de cerrar oportunidades, sino de escuchar, entender, conectar y generar valor real para nuestros clientes.




Stop talking about AI. Start using it.

Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

We are looking for a dedicated and experienced Technical Account Manager to join our team, focusing on our Simulation customers.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Technical Account Manager for Simulation Customers, you will be a pivotal part of our sales team, leading and executing value-driven engagements with organizations heavily invested in simulation. Your primary goal will be to cultivate productive business relationships, understanding their current simulation landscape and guiding them towards advanced Siemens solutions.

Leveraging insights from PreSales tools, you will collaborate with customers and account teams to define strategic Customer Roadmaps. This will involve identifying "land and expand" opportunities by addressing their simulation challenges, showcasing the value of Siemens + Altair portfolio, and helping them achieve greater efficiency and innovation through our technologies. You will build trust by engaging in strategic conversations about industry trends, technical challenges in simulation, and their specific business needs, ultimately crafting compelling value propositions and business cases


Customer Strategy and Planning:
Identify "land and expand" opportunities with our customers, developing ROI-driven business cases for Siemens technologies.
Guide customers and Account Orchestrators on engagement strategies for enterprise opportunities, particularly those involving complex simulation workflows.
Define strategic Customer Roadmaps, identifying expansion opportunities, and articulate the benefits and cost of ownership of Siemens' advanced simulation solutions to C-suite executives.
Consultative Sales & Opportunity Execution:
Become a trusted advisor to simulation customers, offering thought leadership on industry trends, advanced CAE techniques, and Digital Twin strategies.
Articulate Siemens' vision on Digital Thread adoption, demonstrating how integrated simulation drives competitive advantage and process improvement.
Internal Operations:
Manage software forecast and pipeline for Automotive accounts; contribute to planning and internal reviews.
Communicate sales, presales, industry, and customer needs to internal teams, especially product development and marketing for simulation products.
Knowledge Sharing and Mentoring:
Act as the go-to expert for simulation, creating meaningful and best-in-class value propositions across various Digital Threads (e.g., CAE, FEA, CFD, system simulation).
Improve customer engagement models, business cases, and campaign materials to address Xcelerator opportunities in the simulation market.
Bid Management:
Respond to RFPs/RFIs with Siemens DISW solutions, specifically highlighting our strengths in simulation and how they integrate with broader PLM strategies.

Qualifications: 


 Education and Experience:
 Relevant University degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, Civil, Electrical, etc), or a related technical field
Significant experience in simulation software sales, technical presales, or application engineering, with a strong focus on CAE, FEA, CFD, or system simulation.
Experience with various simulation platforms and an understanding of competitive landscapes.
SaaS Sales experience is a plus.
 Advanced English Communication (written and verbal)
Deep understanding of simulation methodologies and applications across industries.
 Good Knowledge of the Following Skills:
Industry knowledge in domains heavily reliant on simulation (e.g., Automotive, Aerospace, Industrial Machinery)
 MS Office
 CRM Software, especially SFDC (desired)
 Presentation and Storytelling
 Teamwork & Collaboration
 Negotiation and Influencing
 Conflict Management
 Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving
 Growth Mindset and Self Development
 Business and Commercial Acumen
 Customer Centricity
 Sales Planning
 Suspect Identification and Development
 Additional (extras) Basic Knowledge of the Following Skills:
 Siemens Solutions and / or equivalent Competitor Software Solutions relevant to the industry.


Scope:


Work with large customers and prospects, primarily those with significant simulation needs or current investments in simulation technologies.
Work within multiple Digital Threads, with a strong emphasis on CAE/Simulation.
Establish and maintain effective relationships with Local Senior Account Orchestrators and Sales Leaders.
Establish and maintain customer relationships up to senior management level.


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
